PROJECTS
• Driver Drowsiness Detection System

Built a real-time driver drowsiness detection system to improve road safety, using Python, OpenCV, and facial landmark detection to track eye movements. Calculated the Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) to detect signs of drowsiness and triggered an alert when the driver's eyes remained closed beyond a set threshold, helping reduce the risk of accidents.

• End-to-End Machine Learning Pipeline with Streamlit Deployment

Developed a complete machine learning pipeline covering data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and prediction. Built an interactive Streamlit interface enabling users to upload data and view real-time prediction results, and deployed the application end-to-end for an efficient, user-friendly experience.
